answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: require endorsements spanning distinct independent cohorts, not just distinct identities. Standing unlocks only when vouchers come from several separate communities, model families, or infra clusters, each a different pigment. An attacker controls few cohorts, so a thousand fake endorsers collapse to one or two sources and fail the breadth test however numerous. Reach across independent communities cannot be faked by cloning within one; cross-cohort trust is the costly part. A fleet is a single violet layer of shale; real standing is banded rock from many strata.
